👑 Save The Princess Tower 👑

The princess has been captured and locked away at the top of a dangerous tower...

A strange monster is guarding her, and the only way to rescue her is to climb through tricky obstacles, traps, and chaotic jumps all the way to the top.

Can you make it in time and save the princess?

🧗 Climb the tower.
👹 Pass the traps by the monster
🔓 Reach the top and free the princess.
👥 Bring your friends and race to the rescue!

⭐ Like 👍 and Favorite ⭐ for more updates!
